newsitem.title: ROMANIA: GLOBAL SECURITIES ENTERS ROMANIA CAPITAL MARKET.
newsitem.headline: GLOBAL SECURITIES ENTERS ROMANIA CAPITAL MARKET.

text.p: Global Valori Mobiliare SA, the Romanian subsidiary of Istanbul-based Global Securities Inc, said on Thursday it had joined in trading on Romania's emerging capital market confident of its potential for growth.
The Global Valori Mobiliare securities company is now active on both the Bucharest stock exchange and on the recently created over-the-counter market, a company statement said.
"We invested in Romania because of the great potential that we see here," the statement quoted Global Valori Mobiliare general manager Selim Cevikel as saying.
"While foreign investors -- both portfolio and industry -- are expressing keen interest to us about this market, so too are Romanians from all walks of life," Cevikel said.

Romania has a bourse since last November with trading involving around 50 securities companies and 13 stocks. An OTC system, called the RASDAQ and modelled on the U.S. NASDAQ exchange, started operating last week. It now trades shares of only six companies and involves seven brokers.
Global Valori Mobiliare is a full service brokerage house offering financial services in sales and trading, corporate finance and research.

"This is going to be a mature market. We are placing our confidence in the evolution of the economy of Romania, the second largest country in Eastern Europe," Cevikel told Reuters. -- Luli Popescu, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264 REUTER
